fit_reason: This is a rotomolded polyethylene sit-on-top kayak. It has no gelcoat, paint or interior that our detailing, buffing or polishing services apply to, so it's not a vehicle we can meaningfully detail.
findings: Hull and deck look clean and uniformly gray in all photos, with no visible grime or staining
Light surface scuffing on the plastic hull side near the 133X decal, which is normal for rotomolded plastic and not something a polish would change
Nonskid deck pads and seat look clean and intact
message: Hi Jerry, we saw your listing for the Ascend 133X kayak, and it looks clean and well kept in the photos. We do pre-sale detailing for cars and boats in the area and come to you, so keep us in mind if you ever sell a vehicle or a gelcoat boat. Would you like a quote for anything like that down the road?
